The underlying cause is unknown; those measurements do not establish whether prefix caching, graph behavior, scheduling, or another factor caused the improvement. The accepted prefix-caching configuration is already tested, so the next legal untested experiment is enforce_eager=false, corresponding to the available graph-execution technique. Baseline sampled_peak_memory_mib was 88303 and trial_1_sampled_peak_memory_mib was 88305, so memory impact is also not causally established. This trial tests whether graph-enabled execution changes latency under the same quality and workload constraints; its result should be interpreted against the exact baseline and the prior accepted trial, not as a claimed gain.
